elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 5.5 states that the Company owns the Site, all other deliverables, and work product created by HDI for the Company.

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI expressly assigns all right, title and interest in the listed Site, deliverables, and work product to the Company.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: HDI expressly retains ownership of its pre-existing software, systems, tools, and know-how.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The licence to HDI materials incorporated in the Site or any deliverable is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The licence to incorporated HDI materials is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The licence to incorporated HDI materials is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The Company owns all right, title and interest in customer, order, transaction, and user data defined as Company Data, and no such rights transfer to HDI.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: Section 5.5 expressly states that nothing in the Agreement creates joint ownership of the identified intellectual property.

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: HDI retains ownership of its pre-existing systems, tools, and know-how.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the Site and deliverables outright, and its licence to any retained HDI materials incorporated in them is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the Site and deliverables outright, and its licence to any retained HDI materials incorporated in them is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the Site and deliverables outright, and its licence to incorporated HDI materials is expressly worldwide.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the Site and deliverables outright, and its licence to incorporated HDI materials is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the deliverables and expressly may use and modify incorporated HDI materials without a narrower purpose restriction, which includes use for its business.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the deliverables and expressly may sublicense incorporated HDI materials without a narrower purpose restriction, which includes sublicensing for its business.
